title: Physics For Integrated Science
mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the point at which the elastic material loses its elasticity permanently and become plastic."
Yield point is the point at which the elastic material loses its elasticity permanently and become plastic.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the E.M.F of the cell because there is no resistor."
Whatever the voltmeter reads is the E.M.F of the cell because there is no resistor.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the surface that divides the system from the surroundings."
Boundary or Wall is the surface that divides the system from the surroundings.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the one that cannot be caught in a screen."
A virtual image is the one that cannot be caught in a screen.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the energy an object has because of its position in a gravitational field, or similar environment that affects the object."
Potential energy is the energy an object has because of its position in a gravitational field, or similar environment that affects the object.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are described by kinetic theory of gases."
Small-scale gas interactions are described by kinetic theory of gases.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are the instruments used to measure the temperature of a body or a system."
Thermometers are the instruments used to measure the temperature of a body or a system.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a device or tool which allows a force (or effort) applied at one point to overcome a resisting force (or load) at another point."
A machine is a device or tool which allows a force (or effort) applied at one point to overcome a resisting force (or load) at another point.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a sound heard after the reflection of sound from a plane surface."
An echo is a sound heard after the reflection of sound from a plane surface.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a disturbance which travels through a medium transferring energy from one point to another without causing any permanent displacement of the medium."
A wave is a disturbance which travels through a medium transferring energy from one point to another without causing any permanent displacement of the medium.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is referred to as a ray of light."
Narrow stream of light is referred to as a ray of light.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the region where an electric force is experienced by a charged body."
Electric field is the region where an electric force is experienced by a charged body.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the rest of the universe outside the region of interest (i.e. the rest of space outside the system)."
Surrounding is the rest of the universe outside the region of interest (i.e. the rest of space outside the system).
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are the screw jack, wheel and axle, the wedge, the inclined plane, wheel barrows, nut crackers, pulleys, pliers and so on."
Examples of machines are the screw jack, wheel and axle, the wedge, the inclined plane, wheel barrows, nut crackers, pulleys, pliers and so on.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the energy associated with an object by virtue of its motion."
Kinetic energy is the energy associated with an object by virtue of its motion.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the bending of a light ray as it crosses the boundary between two media of different densities, thus causing a change in its direction."
Refraction is the bending of a light ray as it crosses the boundary between two media of different densities, thus causing a change in its direction.
fib: ______ is the study of the effects of work, heat, and energy on a system.
Thermodynamics
Thermodynamics is the study of the effects of work, heat, and energy on a system.
______ means an increase in the size of an object.
Expansion
Expansion means an increase in the size of an object.
______ is used for measuring large amount of current.
Ammeter
Ammeter is used for measuring large amount of current.
______ is a standard fixed-point temperature (T3) for the calibration of thermometers.
value
value is a standard fixed-point temperature (T3) for the calibration of thermometers.
______ is the force of attraction between molecules of different kind, e.g the molecules of water and glass.
Adhesion
Adhesion is the force of attraction between molecules of different kind, e.g the molecules of water and glass.
______ is the tendency of a liquid to rise or fall in a narrow tube.
Capillarity or capillary action
Capillarity or capillary action is the tendency of a liquid to rise or fall in a narrow tube.
______ is a restricted region of space or a finite portion of matter one has chosen to study.
System
System is a restricted region of space or a finite portion of matter one has chosen to study.
______ is a change in position of a body with time, which involves how things move and what makes them to move.
Motion
Motion is a change in position of a body with time, which involves how things move and what makes them to move.
______ is a longitudinal wave and a form of energy produced by vibrating body.
Sound
Sound is a longitudinal wave and a form of energy produced by vibrating body.
______ is the ability or capacity to do work.
Energy
Energy is the ability or capacity to do work.
______ are those waves that require a material medium for their propagation.
Mechanical waves
Mechanical waves are those waves that require a material medium for their propagation.
______ is the forces of attraction between molecules of same kind, e.g the molecules of water.
Cohesion
Cohesion is the forces of attraction between molecules of same kind, e.g the molecules of water.
______ are derived of two or all three combinations of the fundamental physical quantities, ditto the units.
Derived quantities
Derived quantities are derived of two or all three combinations of the fundamental physical quantities, ditto the units.
______ is the maximum stretching force beyond which the stretched material would not return to its original length when the force is removed.
Elastic limit
Elastic limit is the maximum stretching force beyond which the stretched material would not return to its original length when the force is removed.
______ is the arrangement and connections of all the electrical parameters, such as the battery, a wire, a load (e.g. an electric bob) and a key or a switch.
circuit
A circuit is the arrangement and connections of all the electrical parameters, such as the battery, a wire, a load (e.g. an electric bob) and a key or a switch.
______ is a wave that transfers energy in travelling or moving away from the source of the disturbance.
Progressive wave
Progressive wave is a wave that transfers energy in travelling or moving away from the source of the disturbance.
